title: Connect stored traces with rubrics and expertise
text: The twelve-factor note includes evaluation rubrics, retained operational traces and encoded expertise as parts of a learning system. Together they suggest that trace collection is useful only when the organisation can interpret outcomes and revise a tested process.
qualification: Design doctrine, not evidence that additional data automatically compounds business advantage. Sensitive traces need purpose and retention limits.
